title: code
description: Code, under its title, file and language; its lines go in as they are, and a long one scrolls sideways (folds on paper). start numbers the lines and mark marks some. A button over it copies the code, without the numbers. Draw no diagram or table in its text: write them as a diagram, table or tree

lang.description: The language, shown at the right above the code

file.description: The file the code is of, its path, shown above it; what the code shows goes in title

title.description: What the code shows, in words, above it; the file it is of goes in file

start.description: The number of the first line, as in its file: written, the lines show their numbers

mark.description: The numbers of the lines to mark, as they are numbered: from start, or from 1 without it. A number no line has marks nothing
